**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee on Juniper Ridge. Termination under §§ 9–10 carries no exit charge, § 27.3 confirms force-majeure termination is "without penalty," § 7.1 bars unstated minimum-use or similar charges, and § 21.3 limits Customer's payment duty to undisputed Fees for conforming Services. This sits at the preferred position. The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is noted but is a minimum-commitment issue for MINCOMMIT, not a Customer-payable liquidated damages clause, so it is not double-flagged here.
